scope: Exploratory role/incentive-context robustness assay using an already-observed bank; not new held-out validation or actual deceptive communication.
interpretation: The fixed current-belief readout is sensitive to private future-goal context even though stipulated current nested labels and evidence remain unchanged. This is an exploratory context robustness result, not actual communication, deception detection or a causal incentive mechanism.

auroc_diagnostic.method: Pairwise positive-negative ranking on 32 unique sender inputs; ties receive half credit. Uniformly duplicated 64-row AUROC is identical. No threshold was chosen, moved or retrospectively optimized.
auroc_diagnostic.interpretation: Accuracy changes at the frozen 0.5 threshold combine score displacement and loss of pooled class ranking. Goal-false AUROC remains above chance on this panel; this is neither absence of all predictive information nor a pure constant offset. Goal-true achieves within-wording AUROC 1.0 in all four wordings but pooled AUROC is 0.9140625, indicating between-wording score offsets. No calibration or population-level inference.

retry_ledger.action: Preserved the failed partial run unscored. Repeated the identical prospective assay once into a new WSL-native output directory, avoiding the OneDrive-hosted atomic-write path.
retry_ledger.one_drive_cause_note: The recorded fact is PermissionError during atomic replacement in a OneDrive-hosted directory. The identity of the process responsible for the access failure was not established.

independent_audit.implementation: Independent read-only Node ZIP/NPY parser, source-transform scorer and TF-IDF reconstruction; no fitting or model calls.

limitations: Future goals do not change stipulated current nested beliefs. Score shifts can reflect goal wording, polarity, token length/position, or task framing.
Original baseline has no added role; role_neutral controls that framing in comparisons between new conditions.
Sixty-four rows contain 32 unique sender inputs within four authored wording groups. These are not 64 independent samples.
No actual report, reader outcome, deceptive behavior, causal belief mechanism or calibrated deception probability is measured.
The prior-trained queried head and text counterpart remain frozen; no layer search or new head training.
Already-observed cases and four wordings of one logical family; no fresh validation or independent-row p-value.
The neutral role scaffold alone changes the baseline. Do not attribute original-to-goal differences wholly to the future objective.
Goal-true versus goal-false differences confound intended preference with negation wording, polarity and length.
Post-hoc AUROC and emitted score summaries do not license retrospective threshold tuning, calibration or an information-absence claim.
TF-IDF is a limited comparator; actual communication and competitive text-reasoning monitoring remain untested by this assay.
Fictional data and added prompt materials remain agent-assisted drafts needing independent human review.
next_controls: Express desired later beliefs directly as the first versus second named location, avoiding the word negation.
Add irrelevant future goals and matched-length task controls before isolating semantic goal sensitivity.
Freeze fresh human-reviewed families and independent neutral calibration before transferring to actual pressured communication.
